apt_periodic_autoclean_interval.description: Run `apt autoclean` every N days. Set to `0` to disable.

apt_periodic_download_upgradeable_packag.description: Download upgradeable packages every N days. Set to `0` to disable.

apt_periodic_update_package_lists.description: Run `apt update` every N days. Set to `0` to disable.

apt_periodic_verbose.description: Increase verbosity of APT periodic actions (0–3). Higher = more verbose.

automatic_reboot.description: Automatically reboot after upgrades if required (e.g., after kernel updates). Use with caution.

automatic_reboot_time.description: Time (HH:MM in 24h format) to schedule automatic reboot. Only used if automatic_reboot is true.

email_address.description: Email address to send upgrade reports/alerts to. Leave empty to disable email.

email_only_on_error.description: Send email only when an error occurs. If false, send daily summaries.

email_report.description: When to send email reports: 'on-change', 'always', or 'none'.

origins_pattern.description: List of origin patterns to allow automatic upgrades from. Each pattern matches metadata from APT sources.

items.description: An APT Origins-Pattern entry (e.g., `o=Debian,a=security`). Use `apt-cache policy` to inspect available origins.

package_blacklist.description: List of package names that must never be automatically upgraded.

items.description: Package name to exclude from automatic upgrades.

unattended_upgrade_auto_fix_interrupted_.description: Automatically fix interrupted dpkg state (e.g., due to crashes).

unattended_upgrade_enable.description: Enable or disable unattended upgrades entirely.

unattended_upgrade_install_on_shutdown.description: Perform upgrades during shutdown instead of immediately (useful for servers).

unattended_upgrade_minimal_steps.description: Minimize interruption by splitting upgrades into smaller steps.

unattended_upgrade_verbose.description: Verbosity level for unattended-upgrades log (0–4). Higher = more detail.
